summary: MINISO Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing that CFO Jingjing Zhang acquired roughly HK$2.7 million of the company's ordinary shares in the open market on September 29, 2026, following an earlier approximately US$400,000 purchase in December 2023. The filing is an insider open-market purchase disclosure, not a corporate special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, stake percentage, or transaction terms were stated. Management indicated possible further purchases subject to market conditions and discretion. What to watch: any follow-on insider buying or accumulation signals sentiment, but no deal or structural event is present.
